in_text_mentions: anterior mediastinal mass. A chest CT with contrast showed a 7.0 × 7.5 × 9.8 cm circumscribed heterogenous partially enhancing mass with variably attenuating components, including adipose tissue, enhancing soft tissue, and dense calcific densities. No mediastinal or axillary lymphadenopathy was observed. The mass effects included compression of the right atrium and superior vena cava, a mild right-to-left shift of the heart, and right lung atelectasis (Figure 1a–d). An ultrasound of the abdomen and pelvis showed no abdominal or pelvic pathology. The overall impression was mediastinal teratoma.
